explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that picks, from a finite set of indices, an element of maximal valuation and shows the quotients g i / g i₁ lie in the valuation subring. I grepped Mathlib/RingTheory/Valuation for exists_max_image and exists_normalizer. I also grepped Mathlib for "∃ i ∈ t" statements that compare valuations. Neither search matched. The proof combines Finset.exists_max_image with ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff, and the result is not a one- or two-line consequence of a single Mathlib lemma.
